# Class `puc::app::Theme`

Stores and resolves semantic colors independently of rendering policy.

Frames ask for roles such as text, warning, or diff background instead of embedding RGB literals. [Theme](#) itself does not emit terminal escape sequences; [Canvas](classpuc_1_1app_1_1_canvas.md) cells carry the resolved values to [Screen](classpuc_1_1app_1_1_screen.md).

[Source](../../puc-cli/tui/rendering/theme.hpp#L20)
